Examples

// Phone number: (NN) NNNNN-NNNN
var phoneConverter = new PatternStringConverter("(NN) NNNNN-NNNN");

// License plate: LLL-NANN
var plateConverter = new PatternStringConverter("LLL-NANN");

Remarks

Pattern characters:

  • A - Alphanumeric (letters and digits)
  • N - Numeric (digits only)
  • L - Letter (letters only)

Any other character in the pattern is treated as a literal separator.
